storyboardBeats.narration: New brakes squeaking? That's not always bad news.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro, brand-new brake pad and rotor freshly installed on a car up on a lift, clean bright metal catching a slow rack light sweep, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Fresh pads leave a thin resin layer on the rotor — that's usually what you're hearing.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro close-up of a brake rotor surface with a faint bluish-grey heat-glaze film, subtle heat shimmer, soft key light, slow lateral pan across the surface, texture-forward, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A proper bed-in — a few hard stops from speed, no full stop — burns that glaze off evenly.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Close-up of a car wheel and rotor in motion-blur spin on a shop dyno/lift, fine dust particles catching light, dramatic low-angle, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Still squeaking two or three weeks later? That's worth a second look, not just glaze.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Two brake rotors side by side on a clean shop workbench, one evenly bedded and matte, one blotchy and unevenly glazed, top-down comparison shot, even overhead light, slow pull-back, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: New brakes won't quit squeaking? Send us a message, we'll take a listen. Nick's Tire and Auto — link in bio.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
